ctx.x: You went with Gerard Pochonet to the country to live with his grandmother?

Yes, I went to live with his grandmother. Gerard was a wonderful guy. Gerard was the type of drummer who played for most of the Americans, like Lena Horne, Hazel Scott, and all the great stars when they came in. He had such a terrific beat on drums, and feeling. He was a newspaper man; he was an all-around man and one good thing about him, when musicians were stranded or needed help or recording dates, he always helped them, especially the Americans.
